context_card.cerita: Mbok Sri selesai mengepel ruang tamu pukul 19.00. Pukul 21.00 Nenek mendapati toples nastar untuk tamu besok hilang dari meja kopi. "Hujan deras begini, pasti masih disembunyikan di ruang tamu," kata Nenek.

clue_awal.teks: Yang mengambil toples itu tidak kidal.
Sarung terlalu tebal untuk muat di rak buku atau lemari kecil. Kalau dibungkus sarung, toplesnya pasti di kolong sofa.
Mbok Sri tidak pernah membawa apa pun tanpa kantong kresek.

rt_lemari.teks: Toples nastar ada di dalam lemari kecil, terselip di balik tumpukan buku telepon lama.

rt_kolong.teks: Kolong sofa hanya berisi debu dan sebutir kelereng. Tidak ada bekas benda diseret.

rt_keset.teks: Lantai baru dipel. Satu-satunya jejak baru: sepatu ukuran 42, dari pintu menuju meja kopi.

rt_sofa.teks: Sarung Nenek terlipat di bawah bantal sofa, masih licin bekas setrika.

rt_kursi.teks: Semua kantong kresek di rumah ada di kursi mustard, terlipat segitiga rapi. Tidak satu pun terpakai.

rt_rak.teks: Buku-buku Om Hendra berdebu tebal. Tidak ada satu pun yang bergeser dari tempatnya.

rt_meja.teks: Ada bekas lingkaran toples di meja kopi. Di dekatnya tercium wangi parfum yang mahal.

rt_tirai.teks: Tas belanja batik Nenek tergantung di balik tirai. Bagian dalamnya penuh remah nastar.

rt_jam.teks: Jarumnya berdetak normal. Pukul 21.07, kalau kamu penasaran.

rt_lukisan.teks: Di balik lukisan cuma ada cicak yang sama kagetnya denganmu.

rt_telepon.teks: Telepon berdering sekali, lalu diam. Salah sambung, sepertinya.

rt_foto.teks: Foto Lebaran tahun lalu. Semua tersenyum, kecuali Om Benny yang kesilauan.

teks_kosong_bawaan: Kamu memeriksanya dengan teliti, tapi tidak ada yang mencurigakan.

penjelasan.teks: Pelakunya tidak kidal, jadi bukan Dimas.
Tas belanja Nenek di balik tirai penuh remah nastar: toplesnya dibawa dengan tas belanja.
Mbok Sri selalu memakai kantong kresek, jadi bukan dia. Pelakunya Raka, dan jejak sepatu ukuran 42 cocok dengannya.
Toples nastar ditemukan di lemari kecil bawah telepon.

komentar_nenek: Raka, Raka… kalau mau bikin konten makan nastar, minta saja. Jangan disembunyikan, nanti semutan.

en.judul: The Missing Jar of Pineapple Tarts
en.cerita: Mbok Sri finished mopping the living room at 7:00 p.m. At 9:00 p.m., Grandma found that the jar of pineapple tarts for tomorrow's guests was gone from the coffee table. "With rain this heavy, it must still be hidden in the living room," said Grandma.

clue_awal.A1: Whoever took the jar is not left-handed.
clue_awal.A2: A sarong is too thick to fit on the bookshelf or in the small cabinet. If the jar was wrapped in a sarong, it must be under the sofa.
clue_awal.A3: Mbok Sri never carries anything without a plastic bag.

benda.rt_lemari: The jar of tarts is inside the small cabinet, tucked behind a pile of old phone books.
benda.rt_kolong: Under the sofa there's only dust and a single marble. No sign of anything being dragged.
benda.rt_keset: The floor was just mopped. The only fresh footprints: size 42 shoes, from the door to the coffee table.
benda.rt_sofa: Grandma's sarong is folded under the sofa cushions, still crisp from the iron.
benda.rt_kursi: Every plastic bag in the house is on the mustard armchair, folded into neat triangles. Not one has been used.
benda.rt_rak: Uncle Hendra's books are thick with dust. Not a single one has moved.
benda.rt_meja: There's a round jar mark on the coffee table. Nearby hangs the scent of expensive perfume.
benda.rt_tirai: Grandma's batik shopping bag is hanging behind the curtain. The inside is full of tart crumbs.
benda.rt_jam: It's ticking normally. 9:07 p.m., if you're curious.
benda.rt_lukisan: Behind the painting there's only a gecko, just as startled as you are.
benda.rt_telepon: The phone rings once, then goes quiet. Wrong number, probably.
benda.rt_foto: Last year's Eid photo. Everyone is smiling, except Uncle Benny, who's squinting into the sun.

en.teks_kosong_bawaan: You check it carefully, but nothing looks suspicious.
penjelasan: The culprit isn't left-handed, so it's not Dimas.
Grandma's shopping bag behind the curtain is full of tart crumbs: the jar was carried in the shopping bag.
Mbok Sri always uses a plastic bag, so it wasn't her. The culprit is Raka, and the size 42 footprints match him.
The jar of tarts was found in the small cabinet under the phone.
en.komentar_nenek: Raka, Raka… if you want to film yourself eating tarts, just ask. Don't hide them, or the ants will get them.
